_note: Topics a library node opens under its own default names, which the repo never states because it never has to. Keyed by package/executable. Only unconditional, data-carrying topics: gps/filtered (publish_filtered_gps), accel/filtered (publish_acceleration) and cmd_vel (use_control) open only when a parameter turns them on, and set_pose is a command input nothing in a repo publishes to. Names are relative and are resolved through the launch file's remappings before use.
